subject: Submission: Milestone 2 Deliverable — Superteam Mobile SDK (grant-sol-mobile-042)
body:
Hi Superteam Grant Review Team,

We have completed all requirements for Milestone 2: Biometric Signer Integration & Test Suite!

Here are our deliverable artifacts:
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/superteam-fun/solana-mobile-sdk/pull/42 (Merged to main, commit a3b8c1d, all CI checks green)
- Test Report: 84.6% branch coverage on biometric signer modules
- Documentation: Published live at https://docs.superteam.fun/mobile-sdk/biometrics

Please review our deliverables and release the Milestone 2 allocation of 2,000 USDC to our registered grant wallet.

Best regards,
Alex Vance
Lead Engineer, Solana Mobile Builders Lab
